correctness.rationale: Reconstructed ordinary cut predicate for all C(15,4)=1365 quadruples and 2^15 subsets: precisely 390 disconnected induced four-sets, 29,654 augmented faces with f=(15,105,455,1365,3003,5005,6435,6375,4570,1935,390). Independently formed a greedy 14,781-pair acyclic matching on the full augmented face poset and verified a DAG with 212,910 Hasse arrows and critical cells 5 in dimension 7, 72 in 8 and 15 in 10. Exact signed integral Morse differential C8 -> C7 has five unit pivot columns; rank=5 with a unimodular minor, giving free rank 67 in H8; C10 survives and H7 vanishes. Purity and lower-degree nonzero homology exclude CM/shellability over fields. The computation is exhaustive for this finite graph, not an infinite-family statement.
